name: set-new-password
title: Set new password
description: The second half of a password reset: a new password with live rules, a confirm field that checks on blur, and a choice to sign out other devices.
docs: email names the account being reset, as an initials avatar and the address with the middle of the name masked (showFullEmail turns the mask off). The new password shows its rules ticked off live (rules: default at least 12 characters, upper and lower case, a number or a symbol) and the confirm field reports a mismatch when it is left, never on every keystroke. Sign out of all other devices starts ticked (defaultSignOutOthers). The submit button waits until every rule passes and both fields match, but it stays reachable and a line under it says why in words (how many rules are left, type it again, the two need to match), so a grey button is never the only explanation; pressing it early moves the focus to what is missing. onSubmit({ password, signOutOthers }) returns an error message to show above the form, with the field focused and selected, or nothing; a throw shows a general message, and a second submit is ignored while it runs. On success the card becomes a done panel, with the look of the result state but the card's own heading (so the page keeps its h1) and Continue to sign in (onBackToSignIn, which also adds the quiet Back to sign in under the form) and a line about the other devices when they were signed out. defaultDone starts there for a preview; footer, titleAs and labels work as in the other auth cards.
